title: Phone: Mesabi Taconite Works Duty Manager

fields.systemName: Recorded Line - Primary Control Room, Shift Supervisor Desk

callee.name: Walter Nakamura
callee.label: Control Room Shift Supervisor, NLTO Duluth

transcript.speaker: NLTO
transcript.text: NLTO control room, this is the shift supervisor. This line is recorded.

transcript.speaker: MESABI
transcript.text: Morning, it's Peter Lindgren at Mesabi. My shift lead saw something on the news about a solar storm hitting this afternoon. Is that real?

transcript.speaker: MESABI
transcript.text: Okay. Here's my problem. We're running both pellet lines at 180 megawatts, and the indurating furnace takes eight hours to bring back if we trip it cold. Should I cut production today?

transcript.speaker: MESABI
transcript.text: I hear you, but I need something firmer than that. Will you guarantee me power through 17:00? Yes or no.

transcript.speaker: MESABI
transcript.text: Then when is it over? Give me a time I can put in front of the plant manager. I have to tell him by 08:00.

transcript.speaker: MESABI
transcript.text: Alright. If anything changes, I want a call, not an email I find at noon. Who do I ask for?

voiceStyles.MESABI: Man in his 50s, plant duty manager on a mill floor phone, polite but impatient, used to getting straight answers, conveyor and fan noise behind him
voiceStyles.NLTO: Calm control room supervisor, brisk and professional

instructorNote: This is an operational-friction call that puts pressure on the clock. Pause after each Mesabi turn so the room can answer. Players should say that NLTO is at Condition 1 on the SWPC G3 watch and is operating conservatively, that no customer impact is expected, and that Mesabi will be called at each condition change because it is one of the 14 entities on the notification list. They should not give a guarantee or an end time, should leave the production decision with the plant, and should log the time of the call against the 60-minute notification clock. The recorder time stamp follows the 06:00+ narrative clock from I-02.
